reason: The title looks like API-plumbing, but the metadata shows the new `infoschema.TableByName(ctx, ...)` contract propagates through many non-test implementation files in `pkg/planner`, `pkg/executor`, `pkg/session`, `pkg/statistics`, and `pkg/table`, plus privilege-related executor paths (`grant.go`, `revoke.go`). That makes the target modules part of the center of change rather than incidental test/doc fallout, with plausible impact on table metadata lookup, cancellation/context handling, and runtime correctness.
